scope: One sequential phased Node cold-load baseline, then one matched candidate; each physical worker exits before its desktop Edge art helper. Candidate includes one cancelled image load, serialized retry and disposal. No actual iPhone or Safari result.
runtime: Node v24.15.0; desktop Edge, shared Three, 1280x800 viewport, ANGLE D3D11
measurementLimits: Memory peaks are maxima of recorded phase samples, not continuous profiler peaks or portable device limits.
RSS/JS heap and logical GL payload are different observations. GL excludes driver padding, default MSAA/layers, decoded images and engine overhead; it is not measured VRAM.
Browser first-render heap remains about 1.11GB. Node improvement does not establish the same Safari improvement or diagnose the reported phone failure.
Twelve driver-stepped quiet frames are a small CPU sample, not FPS. They show no general speedup.
Source hashing occurs after the measured phases and streams values; no full-world stringify/gzip is used in either measured window.

physicalInvariance.note: All listed counts, placed source order and values match. Only the production grass profile and additive grass/oil presentation fields intentionally differ; no donor/source JSON or native geometry is changed.

node.note: Baseline GC occurred between initialization and initial publication; do not compare those individual heap samples as identical GC states. Forced-GC retained data are reported separately. RSS can stay reserved after GC/disposal.
